# awscc_apiportal_discovery_configuration (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::DiscoveryConfiguration. Represents an API discovery configuration that controls how APIs are discovered in the account



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `discovery_sources` (Set of String) The AWS services whose resources are scanned to discover APIs.

### Optional

- `discovery_features` (Set of String) Optional discovery capabilities to enable.
- `excluded_resources` (Set of String) ARNs of resources to exclude from discovery.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the discovery configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the discovery configuration.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the discovery configuration was created.
- `discovery_configuration_status` (String) The status of the discovery configuration.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the discovery configuration was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_discovery_configuration.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the discovery configuration

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_discovery_configuration.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_apiportal_discovery_configuration.example "arn"
```
